text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from 101,235 to 86,551, a meaningful decline; I should check that my overall risk and diversification fit my goals and capacity for loss.","The swings have not formed a reliable pattern, so I should not use recent price moves to predict what comes next.","I have not traded, and activity alone is not a goal; I should make deliberate changes only when they serve a clear plan, while avoiding emotional decisions driven by losses."]}
